summary: LogProstyle Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 15, 2026, announcing its board resolved to declare a special cash dividend of US$519 thousand (US$0.022 per share), funded by the remaining unused portion of a previously discontinued share repurchase program. The dividend is payable on June 30, 2026, to shareholders of record as of June 1, 2026, with the ex-dividend date also June 1, 2026. The board recommended the dividend as an efficient use of capital, enhancing shareholder returns while preserving flexibility for long-term growth. The filing is a foreign private issuer report equivalent to a U.S. 8-K for a special dividend. Watch for any subsequent capital allocation changes or operational updates.
